# DataContractGate

> Semantic data-contract enforcement at ingestion. A high-performance Rust
> gateway that validates every event against a rich YAML contract (ontology,
> types, patterns, enums, glossary, computed metrics) and rejects, quarantines,
> or masks bad data before it reaches a warehouse, lakehouse, or ML pipeline.
> In-process validation of the passing stripe-charges catalog samples: p99 0.93 µs and 1,547,368 events/sec on one thread (measured 2026-11-10; `cargo run --release --bin contractgate-bench`, see ops/bench/README.md). Not HTTP latency. Patent pending.

API base URL: https://api.datacontractgate.com
Source: https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate

## Start here

- [Integration playbook for coding agents](https://app.datacontractgate.com/llm-integration.md): Paste this into Claude, Cursor, or Codex. End-to-end, executable: get a key, infer a contract from real samples, write and deploy the contract YAML, wire the producer to POST /v1/ingest, verify with a dry run.
- [LLM output validation playbook](https://app.datacontractgate.com/llm-output-validation.md): Paste this when the job is to validate an LLM's JSON output (OpenAI / Anthropic / vLLM / Ollama / LangChain / CrewAI / MCP). Picks up where the integration playbook leaves off — same backend, different entry point.
- [MCP server](https://app.datacontractgate.com/mcp-reference.md): Official stdio MCP package (`npx -y @nightmoose/contractgate-mcp-server`) — infer, dry-run, deploy, and list quarantine as typed tools.
- [Full documentation bundle](https://app.datacontractgate.com/llms-full.txt): One-shot ingestion for large-context agents — the playbook and every reference doc below, concatenated. Skip the per-link round-trips.

## Reference

- [POST /v1/ingest/{contract_id}](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/v1-ingest-reference.md): Universal HTTP ingest — JSON arrays or NDJSON, idempotency keys, atomic batches, version pinning, dry runs.
- [Zapier](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/zapier.md): Validate Record action. The record a Zap just pulled is posted to `/v1/ingest/{contract_id}`. A failure is quarantined and the Zap stops. A pass continues with the returned payload. Source: `zapier/`. Not in the public Zapier directory until that version is submitted.
- [POST /egress/{contract_id}](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/egress-validation-reference.md): Outbound payload validation — same engine as ingest, returns only the conforming payload so the caller can forward it safely.
- [LLMGate SDK reference](https://app.datacontractgate.com/llm-sdk-reference.md): Python and TypeScript `LLMGate` — constructor options, `completion` / `message` / `validate_only`, auto-repair, `mask_prompt`. Contract name or UUID.
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/integrations/vercel-ai-sdk.md): `@nightmoose/aischemagate` `aischemagateGuardrail` (`wrapGenerate`) and `validateStructuredOutput` for structured output.
- [OpenAI, Anthropic, Pydantic, Instructor](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/integrations/openai-anthropic-structured-output.md): AISchemaGate on structured outputs and Instructor.
- [LangGraph tool gate](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/integrations/langgraph-tool-gate.md): `compliance_mode` check on tool arguments via `POST /egress/{contract_id}`.
- [Webhook quarantine recipe](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/examples/recipes/webhook_quarantine_firewall.py): DataContractGate receiver that forwards only the masked ingest payload.
- [Dagster and Prefect guardrail](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/examples/recipes/pipeline_guardrail.py): Gate batch rows before a warehouse load.
- [Quarantine replay recipe](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/examples/recipes/quarantine_replay.py): Inspect `GET /quarantine` and replay with `POST /contracts/{id}/quarantine/replay`.
- [Contract deploy](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/deploy-contract-reference.md): POST /contracts/deploy and the `contractgate deploy-contract` CLI — atomic promotion to stable, prior-version deprecation.
- [CSV and URL inference](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/csv-inference-reference.md): Generate a draft contract from a CSV file or a public data URL.
- [Quarantine and replay](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/quarantine-replay-reference.md): Review rejected events and replay them against a corrected contract version.
- [Per-run quarantine](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/quarantine-batch-reference.md): Optional `X-Batch-Id` (alias `run_id`) on `POST /v1/ingest/{contract_id}` and `POST /egress/{contract_id}`. `GET /quarantine/summary?contract_id=&batch_id=` counts that run. dbt sends `invocation_id`. Airflow sends `run_id`. Fail the task when `pending` is above zero.
- [Where to enforce contracts](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/architecture/where-to-enforce-contracts.md): Trust but verify at every boundary — ingest, mid-stream, egress, AISchemaGate; Airflow/dbt quarantine-check examples.
- [Contract families](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/contract-families-reference.md): Relate contracts for the same data as it moves ingest → between stages → egress. Each link records `derived_from` and the boundary. `POST /public-contract-families/{id}/fork` copies a public chain into the caller's org in one transaction. The Free contract cap applies to the whole copy.
- [Drop mode](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/drop-mode-reference.md): Count a failing record and store nothing. Quarantine stays the default. The safety cap is watch-only until enforcement is enabled.
- [PII masking](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate/blob/main/docs/pii-masking-reference.md): Declarative `transform:` rules — mask or hash string fields after validation, before storage.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.datacontractgate.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable route inventory for the whole gateway.

## Contract catalog

Ready-to-use data contracts for common client exports. Pick a source, fork the contract, validate the client's file the same day. Full listing: https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog.md — directory: https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog

- [Stripe Charges](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/stripe-charges): Validate a client's Stripe charges export before it hits your warehouse.
- [Stripe charges pipeline](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/families/stripe-charges-pipeline): One family, four contracts — raw ingest, cleaned stage, daily revenue mart, partner payout egress. Fork the whole chain with `POST /public-contract-families/stripe-charges-pipeline/fork`. Not affiliated with Stripe.
- [Shopify orders pipeline](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/families/shopify-orders-pipeline): Raw orders CSV, typed order, warehouse fulfillment notice. Not affiliated with Shopify.
- [GA4 events pipeline](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/families/ga4-events-pipeline): Raw BigQuery event, cleaned event, audience export. Not affiliated with Google.
- [Stripe Customers](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/stripe-customers): Validate a client's Stripe customer export before syncing it.
- [Shopify Orders CSV](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/shopify-orders): Validate a client's Shopify orders CSV export before loading it.
- [QuickBooks Online Invoices](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/quickbooks-invoices): Validate a client's QuickBooks Online invoice export before reconciling it.
- [HubSpot Contacts](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/hubspot-contacts): Validate a client's HubSpot contacts export before importing it.
- [Salesforce Account](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/salesforce-account): Validate a client's Salesforce Account export before loading it.
- [Salesforce Opportunity](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/salesforce-opportunity): Validate a client's Salesforce Opportunity export before pipeline reporting.
- [GA4 BigQuery events](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/ga4-bigquery-events): Validate a client's GA4 BigQuery events export before building models.
- [Square Payments](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/square-payments): Validate a client's Square payments export before it hits your warehouse.
- [Xero Invoices](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/xero-invoices): Validate a client's Xero invoices export before reconciling it.
- [Generic transactions CSV](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/generic-sheets-transactions-csv): Validate an ad-hoc Google Sheet / bank-ledger CSV before loading it.
- [ACS 5-Year 2023 (county)](https://app.datacontractgate.com/catalog/acs-5year-2023-county): Validate county-level Census demographic joins before they hit your warehouse.

## Optional

- [Self-hosted quickstart](https://github.com/nightmoose/contractgate#try-it-in-10-minutes-self-hosted-free): `make demo` runs the real gateway locally — no account, no API key. Same contract format and same endpoints as cloud.
